name: Laura Friedman
bio: a Representative from California; born in New York, December 3, 1966; graduated from Nova High School, Davie, Fla., 1984; B.A., University of Rochester, Rochester, N.Y., 1988; entertainment executive; business executive; faculty, University of California, Los Angeles, Calif.; member of the Glendale, Calif., city council, 2009-2016; Mayor of Glendale, Calif., 2011-2012; member of the California state assembly, 2016-2024; elected as a Democrat to the One Hundred Nineteenth Congress (January 3, 2025-present).
